info.name: Grafana Sync
info.summary: Your Grafana dashboards as native, editable, backed-up Nextcloud files
info.description:
Grafana Sync surfaces your Grafana dashboards as native Nextcloud files. Map a Grafana **folder** to a Nextcloud folder and every dashboard inside it shows up as a `.grafana.json` file — with a real file icon, deep links back to Grafana, and a per-folder sync mode.
- **Sync** — full two-way ownership. Edit a dashboard in the Files app, over WebDAV, or from your desktop client and the change pushes back to Grafana; a sync folder doubles as a complete, restorable backup of every dashboard in it. - **Link** — a lightweight pointer (uid, title, URL) that opens the dashboard in Grafana. Ideal for operator/GitOps-provisioned dashboards that are owned elsewhere and should never be written back.
Because Grafana has real folders, the mapping is a plain folder-to-folder mirror — no tagging scheme to maintain. The link between a file and its dashboard is the stable Grafana **uid** stored in the file's metadata, not the filename, so renaming, moving, and restoring never break the connection.
⚠️ Early development — this build ships the admin **connection** panel only (point the app at Grafana, store a service-account token, and test it). Dashboard sync lands in later releases.
This is a community integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Grafana Labs. "Grafana" and the Grafana logo are trademarks of Grafana Labs, used here only to identify the service this app integrates with.
